reviews.text: James is a wonderful host. He was quick to respond to any questions and made sure we were feeling like at home. The home was very clean, tidy, and provided a peaceful environment that welcomed all ages. There was plenty to do on site and the home was spread out to accommodate multiple people. The best thing about this place is that everything listed about the property on the booking site was 100% accurate and that it is a 2 min drive to the Big Creek Campground. 10/10 would book again and recommend to everyone.

We had a great stay in Ashford! James was very friendly and offered to help should we need. The place was clean and we had plenty to do for our party of 5 to relax and have a good time. We were greeted by a deer everyday 🦌 would definitely recommend as a place to stay for a large party, especially if you’re visiting Mt. Rainier!

We had an amazing stay at James’s place! It was super convenient to get to Mount Rainier and it was nice being able to come back and unwind/relax afterwards. There was a ton to do inside and we had a blast! We definitely recommend and would stay again in the future!
House was perfect! Plenty of space to spread out and the game room, sauna, and hot tub were a huge hit!

James’s place was perfect for our group of six, spacious, comfortable, and in a peaceful, quiet neighborhood very close to the Mount Rainier National Park entrance. The house has plenty of great amenities, including a hot tub, sauna, and games, although we spent so much time hiking that we didn’t get a chance to enjoy them! Highly recommended, especially for anyone visiting Mount Rainier to hike.

This house was a perfect spot for a family vacation. We were easily able to explore Ranier Park while also having a place for good downtime for toddlers. The hot tub was lovely after a day of hiking and the game room was great to entertain adults who can’t sit still 😂.
James was so responsive whenever we needed something. I’ve stayed at a lot of Airbnbs and haven’t had such a wonderful experience with the hosts. We would absolutely come back!!
Great launching pad for Rainier activities. Lovely place with exposed wood and frontier-cabin vibe also stocked with fun activities.

James is a great host and the property location close to the park entrance really helps. The home is nicely stocked up with all things needed for a comfortable stay. Lot of indoor games and the hot tub makes it a great place for spending time with family. The deer made daily visit to the front and back yard without fail and we ended up spotting a bunny too in the front. Thanks for hosting us. Would like to visit again.
Great stay great location!
Thank you for having us.
Amazing place to stay close to the park entrance. Our kids loved all the amenities. Everything you could ask for to come back to after a day at Mount Rainier.
Amazing location right outside of Mount Rainier National Park. Place was amazing and exactly as described with many amenities to enjoy. Would book again!
Great home and a warm host. James was proactive in making sure our stay was comfortable.
Excellent place to stay
Incredible home with great amenities; very well-stocked kitchen; comfortable bedrooms; Guest account on Roku TV was a nice touch. No complaints!
Great space; plenty of room; comfortable beds; close to Mt Rainier Park entrance. Loved having the deer visit the yard each evening and some mornings. Kitchen well equipped. Host very responsive.
We had a lovely time at James’ place. It was perfect for a large family. There were lots of games and amenities and located so close to Mt. Rainier. I would highly recommend this place!

We had an absolutely wonderful time at James’s place in Ashford! We stayed here with family and a toddler, and it was the perfect setup for us. The home was incredibly spacious, well-furnished, and you can tell it was recently renovated—everything felt fresh and very clean.
One of the highlights of our stay was the local "neighbors"—we had deer visiting the property every now and then, which was a magical experience for the whole family. The location is also unbeatable if you are visiting Mt. Rainier National Park; the entrance is so close, making our daily trips very easy.
James was a fantastic host and had the house arranged so neatly for our arrival. We truly loved our stay here and can’t recommend it enough for families looking for a peaceful, high-quality getaway near the mountain. We’d love to come back!

The entire family enjoyed the house. It is perfect for big families and kids. Lots to do and room for everyone to sleep comfortably. We will definitely book again. Also James was extremely responsive when we had to make adjustments to our stay and extremely friendly. I would highly recommend this place for anyone with a big family or group.
The place was great ! Super spacious and loved the play room! James was super nice he put a Christmas tree and decorated the house for the holiday!
The Airbnb was lovely, clean and the host was very responsive! We had a wonderful stay.
We enjoyed our stay here and would recommend to large groups looking for accommodations near Mt Rainier!
